summary: Nextcloud is a self-hosted platform for synchronising and sharing files across devices. It also provides tools for managing calendars, contacts, and email under your own administrative control.
goodFor: It suits individuals and organisations who want to keep their files and productivity data on their own hardware rather than relying on commercial cloud storage.
watchOut: Running a large PHP-based groupware suite requires careful resource tuning and regular updates to maintain security and acceptable performance.
deployNotes: Deployment typically involves setting up a web server running PHP alongside a separate SQL database, with persistent storage attached for user data.
